Israel’s election has ended in a deadlock, with exit polls showing former general Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition bloc neck and neck with Benjamin Netanyahu’s camp. With turnout hitting a two-decade high, coalition talks could stretch for weeks, leaving Netanyahu in caretaker office as smaller parties emerge as potential kingmakers.
